2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — P3 survives with 2 factors (CONFIRMED).** sessions_offset is one method written as three (F-A2: tier-1 formula evaluated on tier-2/tier-3 domains gives their values; on this world tier 1's 75 = 195 − 90 − 30 is the same "billable less every other draw" method tier 2 would apply without the remote row); escalation_level_ratio values the draw by "reprioritized to P1" while ledger row f72f58ad already records resource_level senior_engineer (F-A6; same 1.25 here, so no value effect).
